accepted_burn_source.scope: Burn crate Cargo.toml and complete src tree, CRLF-normalized UTF-8. Core/dependencies are separately bound by renderer build provenance and Cargo.lock.

allocation_bounds.ground_truth_temporary_index_storage: One borrowed source span per visible mesh instance, O(instances), dropped within extraction; no temporary per-index batch copy.
allocation_bounds.image_copier_clone_metadata: Immutable source-image and staging-buffer arrays shared with Arc; row-layout values remain copied scalars and GPU buffers retain shared ownership.
allocation_bounds.readiness_asset_list_cache_scope: Current scene identity plus actual main-world mesh/image/material/future-resource change ticks; asset-list vectors rebuilt on invalidation; GPU prepared-state/pipeline checks remain live.
allocation_bounds.render_fence_scope: Generated immutable indoor scenes and pinned camera/human trajectories; arbitrary custom ECS light/transform/bone edits are outside this qualified token contract; temporal/history effects retain legacy settling.
allocation_bounds.scope: Independent bounded cache/ownership quantities, not a summed process RAM/VRAM cap.
allocation_bounds.worker_scope: Four shared worker threads plus possible joining-caller participation. One median root fork uses disjoint triangle/node slices; this is not a strict global task-count or process CPU-thread cap.

baseline_ancestor_boundary.scope: Previous accepted round had exact replay relative to its predecessor; the older ancestor retained 17 raw RGB channel differences at 16 pixels versus an earlier control. This round's replay does not retroactively resolve that historical exception.

measurement_boundaries.cpu: Full renderer lifetimes, including startup, warmup, prefetch and teardown.
measurement_boundaries.pool_common_steady: Latest lane warmup completion through earliest lane final-capture completion, not process exit.
measurement_boundaries.single_steady: Capture loop after configured warmup through final capture completion.

rejected_early_camera_activation.diagnostic_configuration_note: An initial diagnostic added co-visibility and is excluded from causal qualification; same_configuration_conservative_replay repeats the original five render modes exactly.
rejected_early_camera_activation.reason: Earlier native camera activation changed strict RGB replay; conservative activation restored exact same-configuration glass RGB. Removed before throughput acceptance. The underlying HDR/transmission scheduling mechanism is not conclusively isolated.

benchmark_results.scope: CPU primary environment rays with direct shadow queries and flat material proxies; cache construction and free included; geometry/material setup, convolution, rendering and uploads excluded
CPU primary environment rays with direct shadow queries and flat material proxies; cache construction and free included; geometry/material setup, convolution, rendering and uploads excluded

rejected_fixed_origin_reflection.reason: Allocation-inclusive CPU benchmark was slower for both representative room geometries; rejected before renderer acceptance. No fixed-origin optimization remains in production.
rejected_fixed_origin_reflection.scope: Diagnostic CPU primary environment rays with flat material proxies, direct shadows and cache allocation/free; not end-to-end renderer throughput or GPU utilization.

rejected_ready_consumption_shortcut.reason: No direct-consumption system was instantiated in 32 matched full-quality rooms; the required scheduling update already consumed ready buffers. Extra revision scanning added work. Review also found readiness/projection guard gaps.
rejected_ready_consumption_shortcut.scope: Combined diagnostic screen only; no isolated benefit or exact replay claim for the abandoned path.

scope: Current accepted local full-quality throughput snapshot after fresh qualification/replay/ABBA; progress toward 2x, not a demonstrated 2x or downstream training speedup.

burn_generator_tests.scope: Retained constructor and strict numerical flow/geometry fixtures; not the whole Burn suite.

clippy.scope: Fresh core/Burn all targets, human_motion, -D warnings

validation.compiler_advisory: Existing upstream burn-cubecl 0.21 future-incompatibility advisory; no project Clippy warnings.

independent_oracles.atlas_rows: Copied original full map routine, legacy/leaf/knit/wardrobe/floor styles, cross-band height derivatives and nested scoped scheduling.
independent_oracles.carried_color: Every original sRGB encode/mix/clamp retained; finite bit-equal decode reuse only, original helper/reset on exceptional operation inputs; copied transfer and actual consumed complete map/mip oracles.
independent_oracles.cellular_halo: Original neighbor arithmetic, signed halo positions, full-atlas nearest/wrapped pigment index, strict ties, exceptional coordinates and capacity budgets.
independent_oracles.ground_truth_extraction: Frozen original complete extraction oracle; exact packed vertex/instance bytes, indices, batch order/cull/layers, flow topology, generation and error/prefix behavior. Live mesh events, visibility, semantic/transform changes, skin joint/bind/capture changes, camera teardown, signed zero/nonfinite failures and recovery are covered.
independent_oracles.image_copier_ownership: Immutable source-image/staging-buffer arrays shared with Arc; only successful consumed packets may recycle staging. Existing independent row stripping/combined buffer cap and live GPU/temporal gates rerun.
independent_oracles.mesh_material_overlap: Copied original fixture/shell/object/human planning; semantic/O-voxel tags, bounds, finishes, metadata, exact vertex/index/tangent bytes.
independent_oracles.periodic_halo: Original interpolation and hashes, wrapped borders, bit-adjacent coordinates and honest padded allocation.
independent_oracles.prepared_glaze: Copied original ceramic arithmetic preserves both sRGB encode/decode round trips; independent texel-bit/consumed complete-map/mip replay, authored 512 maps/coexisting programs, sparse/maximum shared capacity budgets, exceptional consumed parameters and nonfinite UV fallback.
independent_oracles.readback_layout: Ordered independent original row stripping at aligned and odd resolutions; checked actual adapter buffer cap with original per-plane/WASM fallback; fresh full capture/GPU replay.
independent_oracles.readiness_extraction_cache: Tests use actual Extract MainWorld resource ticks and replacement/removal/reintroduction; current scene/future asset promotion and RenderAssetUsages changes invalidate correctly. Prepared GPU asset and pipeline state still checked every render.
independent_oracles.scope: Fresh full-core tests; original expressions, exact complete consumed maps/mips plus original mesh/group planning and byte-level tangent output.
independent_oracles.unit_wrap: For finite [0,1) inputs, preserve original float bits including signed zero; elsewhere retain literal rem_euclid. Independent copied-original complete noise fields plus dense coordinate/seam/subnormal/exponent/NaN tests validate this helper; prepared-vs-scalar maps alone share the helper and are insufficient.

native_gpu_fixtures.new_production_indoor_temporal_fixture: Three 321x239 camera views at three physical timesteps; eight modes, exact request/flow epochs, analytic static-world flow<0.005px, terminal masks, eighteen directed co-visibility pairs; no human motion.

native_live_dataset_temporal_export.scope: Retained production LiveDataset Color/Position temporal fixture; legacy object scene, separately from new indoor fixture.
